goal: Break up the oversized P2P message processing function into dedicated helpers
Make navigation, scoping, and code review in message handling easier for maintainers
reviewability: Reviewing the logic now is worthwhile
Needs a mechanical rebase against master
agreement: Broad support for encapsulating logic and easing navigation in P2P message processing
Verified as move-only using color-moved diffs and local coverage testing (pseudoramdom, l0rinc, pablomartin4btc)
Improves diff context and consistency with existing message helpers (maflcko, theStack, stickies-v)
Conceded objection: separate helpers add setup ambiguity compared to a flat switch (davidgumberg)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it is an internal refactoring that improves navigation and scoping without behavioral changes
Eases future review and maintenance in net_processing without resolving bugs or protocol issues
